concentration_flags: UBER is ~71.03% of NAV -- a single adverse event (the pending $40M California wrongful-death ruling, a broader rideshare-safety litigation wave, the pending Delivery Hero acquisition's integration/financing risk, execution/leverage risk from the EUR4.5B euro bond raise, or intensifying robotaxi competition from Tesla's Cybercab rollout, Wayve/London and Uber's own $10B robotaxi commitment) would disproportionately hit the portfolio; cash remains thin at ~10.57% of NAV, so the offsetting cushion against a UBER-specific shock stays limited.

trim_considerations.note: Bringing this back to the ~25% single-name guideline would mean reducing exposure by roughly $421.63 -- a consideration, not an instruction, and one that doesn't account for any tax consequences of selling, which this pipeline has no visibility into.
